reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding — the issue is the absence of a liquidator != borrower check, not a dead function). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is a public fun callable by any untrusted Sui user. Gate 3: liquidate.move is explicitly in-scope and liquidation logic is a named focus area. Severity held at High: impact is per-position liquidation incentive theft, not protocol-wide insolvency; no client_diversity cap field present in scope file. An attacker can trigger this via the liquidate_as_coin public entry point by constructing a Sui PTB that borrows tokens via borrow_flash_loan, calls liquidate_as_coin targeting their own obligation_id, receives the seized collateral plus liquidation incentive back to ctx.sender() (themselves), and repays the flash loan — capturing the liquidation incentive that should reward external liquidators.
